# Several numbers

A connection can use one or several of the business's WhatsApp numbers; list_numbers shows them, and only an active number sends.

With several, a send names its number in from, or replies in a conversation, which fixes the number. create_template names the number whose WhatsApp Business Account gets the template, and create_broadcast always names the number it sends from. The id comes from list_numbers.

One person writing to two numbers has two conversations.

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/concepts#several-numbers
